observations: Four yellow-outlined figures with spiky crowns occupy the composition: a tall central figure in a white shirt lettered 'NFTY INK', a smaller figure lower left, a fox-eared figure upper left, and a disembodied spiked head upper right.
A dense web of light-blue scribble lines fills the background, overlapping green ghost-like shapes and a muted teal ground, while black outlines anchor each figure against the loose mark-making.
The central figure wears dark rectangular sunglasses and black trousers; its arms extend wide, yellow against the white shirt, giving it a broader stance than the flanking figures.
reading: Four spiked yellow figures crowd the space, each with its own posture—one wide-armed and sunglassed at center, one small and low, one fox-eared and tilted, one reduced to a floating head. The lettered shirt reads as a sign within the image. Blue scribble lines weave through all of them, suggesting noise or shared atmosphere rather than separation. The mood reads as loud and slightly absurd.
contextAngle: Within the owned nnotb subset, the immediate title neighbors are nnxyz nnotb #116 and nnxyz nnotb #118. Where #116 fills its frame with two large close-up faces on a saturated yellow ground, #117 pulls back to show full figures across a cooler, more open field.

connections.reason: Both works use yellow as the dominant figure tone and place red cross-hatch marks on facial features, but #116 fills the frame with two large close-up faces on a warm ground while #117 distributes four smaller full figures across a cooler blue field.

rawblocks #61 shares a teal-blue background with loose overlapping scribble lines and yellow forms set against that field, though it works at close range with a single large form rather than spreading multiple figures across the space.

lookingQuestion: The blue scribble lines pass through and behind all four figures equally—does that shared layer make the figures feel connected to each other, or does it read more like a field they are each separately caught in?
ambiguities: The fox-eared upper-left figure holds what appears to be a small blade or scissors shape; the object is not clearly resolved in the line work.
Title-order and recorded-creation order align for this owned nnotb subset, but gaps may exist in the full artist catalogue outside the collection.
